text:
[Council File 26-1420-S1]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to establishing a comprehensive inventory of City-owned artwork and objects located throughout City facilities.
Recommendation for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Rodriguez – Jurado):
INSTRUCT the Office of the Chief Legislative Analyst (CLA), with the assistance of the Department of Cultural Affairs and other relevant City departments, to report to Council on requirements to establish a comprehensive inventory of City-owned artwork, including artworks located in City-owned, leased, operated, or managed facilities. To the extent possible, the report should not the condition of each object and if each artwork and object is a part of the official City Art Collection.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the CLA has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: A motion to create a comprehensive inventory of all city-owned artwork and objects located across city facilities.
